vocabulary.meaning_en: an animal like a big mouse
vocabulary.example: We saw a rat near the rubbish bins.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large male bird with beautiful blue and green tail feathers
vocabulary.example: The peacock opened its colourful tail.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a farm animal with thick wool; the plural is also 'sheep'
vocabulary.note_ar: الجمع لا يتغيّر: one sheep, two sheep.
vocabulary.note_en: The plural is the same: one sheep, ten sheep.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sharp pain from an insect such as a bee
vocabulary.example: A bee sting can be very painful.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bird known for the sound 'coo-coo'
vocabulary.example: We heard a cuckoo in the forest.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make the loud sound a dog makes
vocabulary.example: The dog barks at every visitor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: wanting very much to win or be better than others
to try to make people admire you
vocabulary.example: He likes to show off his new car.
She got a lot of sympathy after her accident.

vocabulary.meaning_en: made to seem bigger or worse than it really is
something you believe is true without proof

vocabulary.example: Our maths teacher is very strict.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way a child is cared for and taught at home
vocabulary.example: She had a happy upbringing in a small village.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not sensible; not likely to happen
vocabulary.example: It's unrealistic to learn a language in one week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: unnecessary worry or excitement about something small
vocabulary.example: Please don't make a fuss about it.

fine_lines.title: let sleeping dogs lie vs barking up the wrong tree
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان فيهما كلاب لكن معناهما مختلف: let sleeping dogs lie = لا تُثِر مشكلة قديمة واتركها كما هي. barking up the wrong tree = أنت مخطئ في افتراضك أو تلوم الشخص الخطأ.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both have dogs, but different meanings. 'Let sleeping dogs lie' = don't restart an old problem. 'Barking up the wrong tree' = you have the wrong idea or are blaming the wrong person.

examples.sentence: They've stopped arguing – let sleeping dogs lie.
If you think I broke it, you're barking up the wrong tree.

fine_lines.title: peacocking vs sadfishing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كلاهما لجذب الانتباه: peacocking = التباهي بالملابس اللافتة أو السلوك الصاخب كي يُعجَب بك الناس. sadfishing = نشر مشاعر حزينة مبالغ فيها على الإنترنت لكسب التعاطف.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both are about getting attention. 'Peacocking' is showing off with bright clothes or loud behaviour. 'Sadfishing' is posting exaggerated sad feelings online to get sympathy.

examples.sentence: He wore a gold suit to the office – that's peacocking!
She posted 'Nobody cares about me' to get likes – classic sadfishing.

fine_lines.title: rat race vs tiger mother
fine_lines.explanation_ar: rat race: نمط حياة العمل الشاق والتنافس على المال والترقية. tiger mother: أمّ صارمة جداً تدفع أطفالها بقوة للنجاح الدراسي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: The 'rat race' is a busy, competitive working life focused on money and promotion. A 'tiger mother' is a very strict mother who pushes her children to succeed at school.

examples.sentence: He left the rat race and moved to the countryside.
My tiger mother made me study every evening.

expressions.meaning_ar: لا تُثِر مشكلة قديمة؛ اترك الأمور كما هي
expressions.meaning_en: to leave a situation as it is, to avoid restarting an old problem
expressions.example: I wanted to ask about the old argument, but I decided to let sleeping dogs lie.

expressions.meaning_ar: حياة العمل المرهقة والتنافس على المال والترقيات
expressions.meaning_en: a busy, competitive way of life where people work hard for money and success
expressions.example: Many people dream of escaping the rat race.

expressions.meaning_ar: التباهي بالملابس اللافتة أو السلوك لجذب الإعجاب
expressions.meaning_en: showing off with your clothes or behaviour to get attention
expressions.example: Stop peacocking in your new shoes and help me carry these bags!

expressions.meaning_ar: أناس يتبعون الآخرين دون تفكير، كالقطيع (كلمة غير مهذبة)
expressions.meaning_en: people who follow the crowd without thinking for themselves (rude)
expressions.example: He calls people who buy every new phone 'sheeple'.

expressions.meaning_ar: مخطئ في افتراضه أو يلوم الشخص الخطأ
expressions.meaning_en: to have the wrong idea or blame the wrong person
expressions.example: If you think I took your pen, you're barking up the wrong tree.

expressions.meaning_ar: مفاجأة سيئة في نهاية شيء جيد
expressions.meaning_en: an unpleasant surprise at the end of something
expressions.example: The holiday was great, but there was a sting in the tail – our flight home was cancelled.

expressions.meaning_ar: نشر مشاعر حزينة مبالغ فيها على الإنترنت لطلب التعاطف والانتباه
expressions.meaning_en: posting exaggerated sad feelings online to get attention or sympathy
expressions.example: Some people think his sad posts are just sadfishing.

expressions.meaning_ar: الأفضل على الإطلاق (اختصار greatest of all time)
expressions.example: Many fans say he is the GOAT of tennis.

expressions.meaning_ar: يعيش في الأوهام؛ يظن المستحيل ممكناً
expressions.meaning_en: to believe something impossible or unrealistic
expressions.example: If he thinks he can finish the project in one day, he's living in cloud cuckoo land.

expressions.meaning_ar: أمّ صارمة جداً تدفع أطفالها للنجاح
expressions.meaning_en: a very strict mother who pushes her children to succeed
expressions.example: Her tiger mother made her do extra maths every day.

grammar.title: Blended words: sheep + people = sheeple
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض الكلمات الجديدة تُصنع بدمج كلمتين: sheep + people = sheeple، sad + catfishing → sadfishing. ونحوِّل الاسم إلى فعل بإضافة ing: peacock → peacocking (يتصرف كالطاووس). وGOAT اختصار من الحروف الأولى: Greatest Of All Time.
grammar.explanation_en: Some new words join two words: sheep + people = sheeple. We can make a noun into an action with -ing: peacock → peacocking. GOAT is an acronym from first letters: Greatest Of All Time.

questions.question: What does 'GOAT' mean?
questions.explanation_ar: GOAT اختصار لعبارة greatest of all time أي الأفضل على الإطلاق.
questions.explanation_en: GOAT stands for 'greatest of all time'.

questions.question: 'If you think I told the boss, you're barking up the wrong tree.' The speaker means...
questions.explanation_ar: barking up the wrong tree = مخطئ في افتراضك.
questions.explanation_en: It means you are wrong / blaming the wrong person.

questions.question: He left his stressful city job to escape the ___.
questions.explanation_ar: rat race = حياة العمل التنافسية المرهقة.
questions.explanation_en: The 'rat race' is a stressful, competitive working life.

questions.question: Which word describes people who copy the crowd without thinking?
questions.explanation_en: 'Sheeple' are people who follow the crowd.

questions.question: The film was happy until the end, when there was a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: a sting in the tail = مفاجأة سيئة في النهاية.
questions.explanation_en: 'A sting in the tail' is a bad surprise at the end.

questions.question: The argument finished last year. It's best to ___.
questions.explanation_ar: let sleeping dogs lie = لا تثر مشكلة قديمة.
questions.explanation_en: 'Let sleeping dogs lie' means don't restart an old problem.

questions.question: Posting 'I'm so sad, nobody loves me' to get attention is called ___.
questions.explanation_ar: sadfishing = نشر الحزن المبالغ فيه لكسب التعاطف.
questions.explanation_en: 'Sadfishing' is posting exaggerated sadness for attention.

questions.question: 'He thinks he'll be a millionaire next week? He's living in ___!'
questions.explanation_ar: cloud cuckoo land = يعيش في الأوهام.
questions.explanation_en: 'Cloud cuckoo land' means believing something impossible.

questions.question: Which word is the correct plural? 'There are ten ___ in the field.'
Wearing a very bright suit to get attention at a party is ___.
questions.explanation_en: 'Peacocking' is showing off to get attention.
